title: Alpha2 frequency-basis search
research_question: Can Alpha2 close part of its accuracy gap to the MLP by changing the Q.ANT Fourier/KAN frequency basis without changing topology?
hypothesis: Alpha2 task fit is partly limited by the fixed k=[1,2,3,4] basis. A frozen alternative basis can improve TRAIN-only validation Q.ANT accuracy while preserving stability.
frozen_architecture: PNN-v1 Alpha2: 12 local 8->8 Fourier/KAN blocks, concatenate 96, Fourier/KAN 96->2 head.

data_protocol.rule: Reuse exact deterministic TRAIN/validation boundary from Exp003-005. Select frequency basis only from validation. Canonical TEST remains untouched until selection is frozen.

primary_metric: Mean validation Q.ANT accuracy across 10 seeds.
selection_rule: Highest mean validation Q.ANT accuracy; tie-break by lower validation standard deviation; then fewer parameters.
success_criteria: Selected non-control basis must exceed k1234 mean validation Q.ANT accuracy by at least 0.02 absolute and have validation Q.ANT standard deviation no more than 0.01 absolute above control. Otherwise retain k1234.
promotion_scope: A successful result promotes only the frequency basis of Alpha2; topology remains frozen.
hardware_boundary: Software/simulation-backend experiment only; no real photonic hardware performance claim.
